findings.reason: a node closing §3 cannot tell which number is the figure the bar reads, so it either invents a correction from an instrument that was ruled out or reports a rate the section's text does not sanction.
findings.text: §3's done-when's no-fit branch requires that "every group rate that reader produces is corrected for its measured recall and false-alarm rate, the corrected rate and its interval being the figure the bar reads", but the same section's ruling (plan.html:37) is that no model reader is fit and "no reader is in the loop", so no reader produces a group rate and no recall/false-alarm pair exists to correct with; the ruled route (docs/evidence/fragments/sn-audited-group-release/reader-calibration.json records chosen_reader_fit false and the page states the measurement does not choose an interim deciding rule) therefore leaves undefined whether the bar reads the raw adjudicated rate or a corrected one, and §4/§5 inherit the undefined figure

findings.reason: the group's post-repair rate, the two-arm repair comparison and every later group's second reading are all computed from this instrument, so naming the wrong instrument produces a rate the bar then judges.
findings.text: §4's done-when reads each member again after repair "by the same readers under the same instructions", but §1 (plan.html:29) defines those readers as the two model readers while §3 (plan.html:37) rules that no model reader is fit and that the audit is adjudication with no reader in the loop, so the second reading's instrument is either the ruled-out readers or unstated; a second reading by the unfit readers (best measured 72.7 % recall, 15 % false alarm, reader-calibration.html) against an adjudicated first reading makes the before/after comparison measure the change of instrument rather than the repair, and §5's "read again after repair as in §4" carries the same ambiguity to every later group

response_events.note: Section 3 now says that with no fit reader no reader produces a rate: the rate is the share the blind adjudication judges defective over every member, uncorrected, undecidable members reported as their own share, and the bar reads the rate with them counted defective.
